recipe: A fresh home contains only .config/st (0700) and the public test private key (0600). Run host twice, remove only evidence-sign.json, then run agent twice. ${home} expands to the fresh absolute home in argv and stderr. No output is otherwise normalized. Reuse preserves all file bytes, modes and timestamps. This key is public test data, never an enrollment credential.
environment: inherited; interpreter uses -I; explicit --home isolates account state

cases.stderr:
signer host/box-1; key ${home}/.config/st/evidence-sign-key; configuration ${home}/.config/st/evidence-sign.json
